[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-q8[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]One tie per task pair — dependencies absorb plain links[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A task pair can hold a dependency or a plain (unlabelled) link, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never both, in either direction. Every Bob writer enforces it. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Reconcile heals hand edits in the dependency's favour. The four [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Obsidian relationship stages show each pair's tie at a glance and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]convert it with Ctrl plus the Task Card key, and capture plus Bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Mac Capture explain the rule.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Contract, shared vectors, and the Rust tie helpers[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tie-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tie-contract: write the plain-link/dependency contract and PT vectors in[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-cli docs, add the shared vector fixture, and add the pure Rust [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]helpers that classify a pair's tie and drop plain entries byte-exactly.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reconcile fold and merge pruning[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]reconcile-fold[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tie-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]reconcile-fold: bob task reconcile drops plain LINKS entries on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dependency-joined pairs and reports absorbed_plain_links. bob task merge[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prunes the overlaps its repointing would create. Dry-run the fold [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]against the live vault without applying it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Capture absorption, the plain-~ no-op, and the same-item error[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]capture-writers[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tie-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-writers: & and * absorb the pair's plain links in the same [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]staged write. A plain ~ / ~~ over a dependency becomes a reported no-op,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and & plus a plain ~ to one target in a single item is a teaching error.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Both report additive JSON and human output.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]capture-complete tie fields[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]capture-complete[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tie-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-complete: relation candidates carry dependency_tie in both [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]directions (also_prerequisite stays as a deprecated alias), and & / * [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]candidates carry plain_link.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Nav tie planner, mirrored vectors, and absorption in the [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]dependency writers[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]nav-tie-planner[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tie-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]nav-tie-planner: add the pure JS twins and planTieChange in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-navigation-hotkeys, pinned by mirrored PT vectors. Every existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]nav dependency writer (Depends on, Blocks, counted, marked, api) then [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]absorbs plain links.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Tie pills, the ⇄ badge, tie bands, subtitles, and the [/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]Depends-on consequence strip[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]nav-tie-visibility[dim] · [dim][/dim]after nav-tie-planner[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]nav-tie-visibility: all four stages show each row's tie in both [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]directions in a new pill cluster, mark converting rows with ⇄, list the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]other kind of tie in an empty-filter band, count it in the subtitle, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]give Depends on its consequence strip, and add the hand-edit notice.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]applyTieChange — release, reverse, and convert writes[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]nav-tie-writer[dim] · [dim][/dim]after nav-tie-visibility, reconcile-fold[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]nav-tie-writer: one guarded writer runs any planned tie change. It [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]writes the dependency side first, keeps same-note changes in one undo [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]step, reports honest notices and follow-up suffixes, and fixes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reopenDependencyStageFresh.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The ⌃B / ⌃⇧B / ⌃L chords, ↵ conversions, and the armed release[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]nav-tie-keys[dim] · [dim][/dim]after nav-tie-writer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]nav-tie-keys: wire the Ctrl chords and ↵ conversions in all four stages [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with strict modifier helpers. A ↵ release takes two presses. Batches and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]counted sessions refuse conversions, and the label stage guards its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plain row. Add the footers and docs, then deploy with bob plugins sync.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture tie capsules and report rows[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-tie-capsules[dim] · [dim][/dim]after capture-writers, capture-complete[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-tie-capsules: decode the new capture and capture-complete fields, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]render the tie capsules, summaries, and report rows, refresh the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fixtures and docs, and watch the exact-SHA macOS CI run to green.[/#D7D7AF]
